description: Implement responsive design improvements for the onboarding and login screens to ensure they display correctly on mobile devices. Update the layout and component behavior at appropriate breakpoints to provide a mobile-friendly user experience.
functional_requirements: Update the three onboarding screens to use responsive breakpoints that adjust layout and styling for mobile viewports
Modify the login screen to be mobile-friendly with appropriate spacing, sizing, and component arrangements
Ensure all affected components (including navigation, popovers, and layout wrappers) maintain proper functionality and appearance across different screen sizes
